title: Ohm Boy Cherry Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Cherry Ice from Ohm Boy is a big, bold Red Cherry flavour that’s intensely delicious and immensely satisfying. The addition of a layer of bracing Menthol brings a super-refreshing icy breeze to this delicious flavour making it an easy all-day vape for fruit lovers. Ohm Boy’s nic salt e-liquids feature a 50VG/50PG blend that strikes a perfect balance between flavour, vapour production, and throat hit. These e-liquids are available in both 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths and their nicotine salt formula makes them ideal for use in e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape kit devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. Due to their unique alkaline formulation, Nicotine Salt e-liquids contain a higher concentration of nicotine compared to regular freebase e-liquids. They also deliver a smoother throat hit at higher nicotine concentrations and are absorbed faster into the bloodstream, providing rapid relief from nicotine cravings. As a result, these e-liquids are ideal for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking fast, satisfying nicotine relief with a smooth throat hit. If you enjoy this flavour, why not explore others in this mouth-watering collection of fruity, frosty blends such as Guava Mango Kiwi Ice, Pink Lemonade Ice or Strawberry Banana Ice? Thanks to their unique and boundary-pushing flavours, Ohm Boy has become one of the most innovative e-liquid manufacturers in the UK. Their range of e-juices spans across fruit, candy, beverage and even coffee blends, each with a distinctive twist on traditional flavours, resulting in a delicious new realm of taste. Ohm Boy's e-liquids are complex and beguiling, with an unparalleled character that sets them apart from others in the market.
